US100 continues its strong bullish drive up to Session High / VAH resistance, while BTCUSD remains locked in a tight chop around its Point of Control.

Given price is right at major lower S/R support inside VA without strong CVD backing, chasing the short here carries poor probability.

Price is inside VA (VAL 28001.73 to VAH 28230.85), trading above POC (28111.52). CVD is BULLISH (+8.50) with positive slope (+1.38), matching the strong upward trend. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is well above VWAP (28065.23) and EMA50 (28039.31), testing the upper ATR band (28237.95) and VAH / Session High (28230.85). Although index tick volume lacks yellow RVOL spikes, the forming M15 bar shows an intrabar pull back off the extreme high (live price 28194.06 vs high 28234.00), offering a potential pullback entry or consolidation setup. Holding for clearer breakout past 28230.

Price is inside VA (VAL 73492.46 to VAH 73788.83) right near POC (73660.40). CVD is NEUTRAL/BEARISH (-0.04) with zero slope. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is hovering around VWAP (73621.61) and EMA50 (73664.53) mid-channel in the ATR envelope (73238.96 to 74102.69). RVOL is low (1.127) with 0 recent volume spikes.
